visual_form.composition_law: One latent token before the act is exercised.
visual_form.spatial_logic: A single small form is isolated with enough negative space to make its unspent capacity visible.
visual_form.figure_ground: The token is present but has not yet reorganized its field.

visual_form.composition_law: A deliberate seam differentiates two fields.
visual_form.spatial_logic: Two forms or regions are set apart by one explicit line, interval, or boundary that makes difference visible.
visual_form.figure_ground: The seam is as important as either side.

visual_form.composition_law: A third form is brought forth by the relation of two.
visual_form.spatial_logic: Two established elements generate a new sign, form, or direction between/beyond them.
visual_form.figure_ground: The third must read as generated, not merely added.

visual_form.composition_law: The differentiating seam becomes a standing frame.
visual_form.spatial_logic: A fixed lattice, box, or categorical architecture stabilizes the earlier split into something buildable.
visual_form.figure_ground: The frame itself becomes the operative figure.

visual_form.composition_law: An incompatible pressure strains the established form toward disclosure or fracture.
visual_form.spatial_logic: One coherent structure is visibly deformed by a force that does not fit its existing categories.
visual_form.figure_ground: Stress reveals what the standing form cannot absorb.

visual_form.composition_law: A clean distinction becomes generative along its own seam.
visual_form.spatial_logic: A new form issues precisely where two differentiated fields meet; cut and production occur in one gesture.
visual_form.figure_ground: The seam becomes a productive channel rather than a wall.

visual_form.composition_law: One form is halted before an answer-demanding fork.
visual_form.spatial_logic: A singular path reaches a crossroads, unresolved threshold, or held question with no neutral continuation.
visual_form.figure_ground: The unanswered fork dominates the available space.

visual_form.composition_law: The founding distinction is wielded as practiced power.
visual_form.spatial_logic: A seam, boundary, category, or sign becomes a tool actively controlled by a mature figure/form.
visual_form.figure_ground: The operator and the distinction it commands form one system.

visual_form.composition_law: Generative abundance turns inward and illuminates itself.
visual_form.spatial_logic: Multiple produced forms curve, reflect, or settle back toward a quiet inner center of understanding.
visual_form.figure_ground: The inner light/center organizes the surplus around it.

visual_form.composition_law: The fully built frame breaks open along its founding seam.
visual_form.spatial_logic: A mature structure reaches culmination exactly where its original distinction becomes the line of transition into the next cycle.
visual_form.figure_ground: The breach is continuity transformed rather than random destruction.

visual_form.composition_law: Tentative first performance of the act.
visual_form.spatial_logic: A young/early figure and one simple tool or relation occupy a field that remains larger than their current command.
visual_form.figure_ground: Attention is wholly on learning the doing.

visual_form.composition_law: The act is driven outward to its active limit.
visual_form.spatial_logic: A figure commits to one extended gesture or vector that crosses and reorganizes the field.
visual_form.figure_ground: The gesture dominates while its consequences remain visible.

visual_form.composition_law: Mastery is internalized into still presence.
visual_form.spatial_logic: A seated or grounded figure holds the suit's relation without visibly exerting it; surrounding marks gather rather than radiate.
visual_form.figure_ground: Presence carries the act without performance.

visual_form.composition_law: Mastery becomes the standard that orders the surrounding field.
visual_form.spatial_logic: An upright figure, sign, or axis establishes a rule that other forms align to, resist, or measure themselves against.
visual_form.figure_ground: The surrounding world visibly takes its organization from the sovereign standard.
